ns2:section.sectionText: Early registration in this section is restricted to approved Math cohort students from Spring 2018 Math 347 C2M and Math 416 E13, as well as students from Fall 2017 Math 347 C2M and Math 417 D13. Any remaining open seats will be made available to all math majors on April 18, 2018, and to all students on April 24, 2018. Students who were part of those cohorts should email mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, 9-digit UIN, and cohort they were in, such as SP18 416 E13.
